label: Syntactic
comment: A conjunction "or" is used with a modifier "individual," which triggers syntactic coordination ambiguity. As a result, the phrase "individual contacts or groups" can be parsed and grouped differently: ((individual contacts) or groups); (individual (contacts or groups)).

Do you need this feature for an individual contact or a group of contacts?
